Ahri.watch: Stay behind minions so Ahri E Charm cannot leave you exposed to all her follow-up damage. Ahri Q Orb of Deception also deals damage on its return, and that damage is true damage, so move out of its return path even after dodging the first pass.
Ahri.build: First consider ways to interrupt or remove Ahri E Charm, and build magic resistance against the magic damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception, Ahri W Fox-Fire, and Ahri E Charm. Magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from the return of Ahri Q Orb of Deception. If the healing from Ahri P Essence Theft is enough to prevent a kill, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Ahri.fight: When Ahri E Charm is down, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil, deal a brief burst of damage, and leave. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is available, she can chase, so time your engage for when it is down. When she engages with Ahri R Spirit Rush, slow her with Aurora E The Weirding and leap backward.
Ahri.laning: Stay behind minions to avoid Ahri E Charm, and land Aurora Q Twofold Hex when Ahri steps up to last-hit. Weave in a basic attack before the recast to stack Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, heal, and take a short trade. After pushing the wave, use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and approach another lane.
Ahri.combo: After Ahri E Charm is down, use Aurora Q Twofold Hex's first hit → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Lower her health with the basic attack and Aurora E The Weirding before the recast to benefit from its missing-health damage. Aurora E The Weirding leaps backward, so check your retreat direction first.
Ahri.escape: The moment Ahri E Charm misses or goes on cooldown is your chance to close in. If the kill is not certain, do not engage first with Aurora W Across the Veil expecting its cooldown to reset.
Ahri.phase: In the late game, play toward completing three core items.
Ahri.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Ahri R Spirit Rush is available. Once Ahri's engage ability is down or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, then deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If you have just avoided Ahri E Charm, you have a chance to target her.

Akali.watch: If you are marked, the second dash will follow even if you flee. If it lands, slow her with Aurora E The Weirding and leap backward to create distance.
Akali.build: Aurora's mainly magic damage can be blunted by Akali's high magic resistance, so add magic penetration. Build magic resistance over armor, and get health to withstand the missing-health damage from Akali R Perfect Execution. The available information does not establish a specific first item to buy.
Akali.fight: When Akali steps up to last-hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in a basic attack, then recast it. If Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack or engages with Akali E Shuriken Flip, slow her with Aurora E The Weirding and retreat. If Akali still has a mobility ability available, do not use Aurora W Across the Veil to close in deeply first.
Akali.laning: After pushing the wave, you can use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and roam.
Akali.combo: When Akali's engage tools are down and you can close in, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex.
Akali.escape: Do not go in deeply just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down. Close the distance with Aurora W Across the Veil during a window before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back, after checking her remaining mobility options.
Akali.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after she completes three core items, so keep poking and farming safely until then.
Akali.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution are available. Once Akali's engage ability is down or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, then follow up with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If your team needs to retreat, end the zone early and leave with them.

Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is his main source of damage and has a knockup, so when you see its cast, move outside or inside the blade's tip area. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave its area immediately and keep Aurora W Across the Veil available for when you need it. While Aatrox R World Ender is active, his healing and attack damage increase, so avoid dueling him and wait it out.
Aatrox.build: Aatrox deals mainly physical damage and Aurora has low armor, so start Cloth Armor, build armor first, and choose Plated Steelcaps. The healing from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance, Aatrox E Umbral Dash, and Aatrox R World Ender is a concern, so buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Aatrox.fight: Right after Aatrox uses the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion, hit him with Aurora Q Twofold Hex as he steps up to last-hit, weave in a basic attack, and take a short trade. If he engages with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, counter with the slow and backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding. Once Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, you have a chance to close the distance, but if Aatrox R World Ender is active, create distance first.
Aatrox.laning: When Aatrox steps up to last-hit, repeatedly take short trades with Aurora Q Twofold Hex and basic attacks to stack Aurora's passive, then back off. After pushing the wave, you can use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and roam.
Aatrox.combo: If Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down and you can engage, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. After leaping backward with Aurora E The Weirding, position so the recast path still hits.
Aatrox.escape: If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, leave its area immediately before it pulls you back, using the Aurora W Across the Veil you kept available if needed. The best time to engage is right after you draw out Aatrox E Umbral Dash. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains is also down, you can close the distance with Aurora W Across the Veil or Aurora E The Weirding. If the kill is not certain, do not jump in first expecting Aurora W Across the Veil's cooldown to reset.
Aatrox.phase: Early on, Aatrox's empowered basic attack and an early lead are dangerous, so focus on poking and farming without giving up kills. Aurora's win rate rises after three core items, so grow steadily until then.
Aatrox.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Aatrox E Umbral Dash is available. Once Aatrox's engage ability is down or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, then deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If your team needs to retreat, end Aurora R Between Worlds early and leave with them.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so do not feel safe behind the minion wave; dodge both its outgoing and return paths. If Akshan engages with Akshan E Heroic Swing, hit him with Aurora E The Weirding to slow him and leap backward to create distance. If you are low on health and the targeting indicator for Akshan R Comeuppance appears, move behind terrain instead of fleeing alone into the open.
Akshan.build: Akshan deals mainly physical damage and Aurora has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Akshan.fight: When Akshan steps forward to last-hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in a basic attack to stack Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing goes on cooldown, use Aurora W Across the Veil to close the distance and look for a fight.
Akshan.laning: When dodging Akshan Q Avengerang, do not just stay behind the minion wave; watch its return path too. After pushing the wave, you can use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and roam, but keep vision of Akshan approaching with Akshan W Going Rogue around the river and jungle walls.
Akshan.combo: If Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, attack with the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Aurora E The Weirding leaps backward, so check your retreat direction.
Akshan.escape: Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing goes on cooldown is your window to approach with Aurora W Across the Veil. If Akshan E Heroic Swing is still available, do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds; counter his engage with Aurora E The Weirding and create distance.
Akshan.phase: Aurora’s win rate rises later in the game once she has three core items, so focus on scaling to that point instead of forcing kills early.
Akshan.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Akshan E Heroic Swing is available. Once Akshan E Heroic Swing is down or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, then deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If you have the villain mark, avoid facing Akshan alone and fight outside his finishing range.

Ambessa.watch: When you see Ambessa W Repudiation wind up, stop attacking and move out of its range. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, use Aurora E The Weirding or Aurora W Across the Veil to create distance immediately instead of waiting for the slow to end. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the farthest champion in a line, so do not line up with your backline during a standoff.
Ambessa.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ambessa deals mostly physical damage, and Aurora has low armor, so build armor first.
Ambessa.laning: When Ambessa steps up for a last hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in a basic attack, then recast it. Use the healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration for short trades. After pushing the wave, use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and roam.
Ambessa.combo: After Ambessa uses her abilities and empowered basic attack charges, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Weave in the basic attack to stack Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then use the backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding to create distance before dealing the return damage. If you see Ambessa W Repudiation wind up, stop the combo and move out of its range.
Ambessa.escape: Go in right after Ambessa uses all her abilities and empowered basic attack charges. When using Aurora W Across the Veil to engage, judge whether a takedown can reset its cooldown. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, immediately disengage with Aurora E The Weirding or Aurora W Across the Veil.
Ambessa.phase: In the mid game, Ambessa is strong once she has core items, so avoid giving her kills and keep up in levels. Aurora's win rate rises after three core items; until then, keep harassing and farming safely.
Ambessa.teamfight: Do not stand in the line of Ambessa R Public Execution with your backline. While Ambessa's engage abilities are available, do not dive in first with Aurora R Between Worlds. Enter after the enemy uses its initiation abilities or an ally lands crowd control. Then create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds and apply the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the return damage from Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Azir.watch: Watch the attack range of soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise! and the path they can take with Azir Q Conquering Sands. If you force your way in while Azir E Shifting Sands is available, he can escape. In a narrow passage, Azir R Emperor's Divide can push several teammates back together.
Azir.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave a soldier's telegraphed attack range. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Azir's magic damage.
Azir.fight: After Azir uses Azir Q Conquering Sands to move his soldiers, circle around them while they are stationary to reach Azir himself. When Azir steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, add a basic attack and Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex for a short trade.
Azir.laning: Pressure Azir when his soldiers expire or his mana runs low. After pushing the wave, you can roam with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Azir.combo: If Azir E Shifting Sands is down, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex after lowering his health with the basic attack and Aurora E The Weirding, and check where its backward leap will take you before using it.
Azir.escape: Right after forcing Azir E Shifting Sands is your chance to close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is also down, engage with less risk of being pushed back. When Azir comes in with Azir E Shifting Sands, slow him with Aurora E The Weirding and leap backward.
Azir.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after three core items, so reach that point through safe harassment and farming rather than forcing kills.
Azir.teamfight: Do not dive in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Azir E Shifting Sands is available. After Azir uses his way in or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds in an open area and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the return of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Do not group up to enter through a narrow passage, where Azir R Emperor's Divide can push you back together.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health and grants bonus damage and Stardust when it keeps hitting the same target. Stand behind minions and quickly leave its line of fire. At low health, avoid the area of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, which can execute you. In the late game, spread out so you are not hit together by an empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.build: Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Because Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light scales with maximum health, consider movement speed to escape Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend instead of stacking health alone. If the enemy team has a lot of crowd control that can hold Aurora in place, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items.
AurelionSol.fight: Right after Aurelion Sol uses Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is your chance to close the gap. When he steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, stack Aurora P Spirit Abjuration with basic attacks, then back off. If Aurelion Sol comes in with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, counter by slowing him with Aurora E The Weirding and leaping backward.
AurelionSol.laning: After pushing the wave, use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and roam, putting pressure on Aurelion Sol's Stardust growth.
AurelionSol.combo: If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and approach with Aurora W Across the Veil. Weave in basic attacks to stack Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then slow him with Aurora E The Weirding while leaping backward. Once Aurelion Sol's health has dropped, recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex to deal damage based on missing health.
AurelionSol.escape: Engage right after forcing Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. Close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil, but if a takedown is not certain, do not overcommit expecting a cooldown reset. Do not dive in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while the crowd control from Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is still available.
AurelionSol.phase: In the mid game, harass safely, push waves, and roam to slow Aurelion Sol's growth. In the late game, his permanent Stardust stacks make it harder to catch him from the same angle, so spread out with his empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend in mind.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Do not dive in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is available. After the enemy uses its engage or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the return of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Keep your distance from teammates so several of you are not hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend together.

Annie.watch: When white light swirls around Annie, the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, so stay out of her ability range. After Annie R Summon: Tibbers appears, keep your distance from Tibbers even if you kill Annie.
Annie.build: Annie deals magic damage, so build magic resistance first. The penetration from Annie R Summon: Tibbers cuts through some of that resistance, so positioning to avoid the stun and movement speed also matter. If the enemy team has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, including Annie's stun, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items.
Annie.fight: When Annie has just used the stun from Annie P Pyromania and steps up for a last hit, start a trade with Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Weave in basic attacks to stack Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. If Annie approaches to trade back, slow her with Aurora E The Weirding while retreating.
Annie.laning: After pushing the wave, you can use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and roam.
Annie.combo: Do not recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex as soon as it lands. First lower Annie's health with basic attacks and Aurora E The Weirding. You can still deal damage along the return path of Aurora Q Twofold Hex after creating distance with the backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding.
Annie.escape: Annie has no movement ability, so right after she uses the stun from Annie P Pyromania is your chance to go in with Aurora W Across the Veil. If a takedown is not certain, do not go deep expecting its cooldown to reset. Check your retreat path, then slow Annie with Aurora E The Weirding while leaping backward.
Annie.phase: Prioritize safe harassment and farming over forced kills until Aurora reaches the three core items after which her win rate rises.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is out of sight or the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, do not stand on top of an ally. After Annie uses her initiation abilities or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the return of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Annie R Summon: Tibbers may remain where the fight ended, so keep your distance.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost explodes and stuns when recast, so stay outside its range rather than relying on a small sidestep. If it hits you, or Anivia R Glacial Storm chills you, escape with Aurora W Across the Veil or Aurora E The Weirding before Anivia E Frostbite deals its empowered damage. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your retreat.
Anivia.build: Anivia's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of crowd control that can lock down Aurora, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items to prepare for getting trapped after engaging.
Anivia.fight: Close the gap and take a short trade after Anivia Q Flash Frost is down. Anivia has no mobility skill, so land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, use basic attacks to build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then retreat while slowing her with Aurora E The Weirding. If Anivia P Rebirth is available, pressure her with your team rather than trying to secure the kill alone.
Anivia.laning: When Anivia steps up to last-hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in basic attacks, then recast it for a short trade.
Anivia.combo: While Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and approach with Aurora W Across the Veil. Weave in basic attacks, then use Aurora E The Weirding to deal damage, slow her, and leap backward. Recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex last. Delaying the recast lets it deal more damage based on the health she has lost in the meantime.
Anivia.escape: Look to engage when Anivia Q Flash Frost is down. Her lack of mobility gives you a chance to close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil, but think carefully before using your escape to engage if the kill is uncertain. Avoid engaging in narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your retreat.
Anivia.phase: Late game, watch out for Anivia's terrain control and farm safely until Aurora has three core items.
Anivia.teamfight: Fight in open areas when possible, since Anivia W Crystallize can block narrow passages. After the enemy's engage abilities are down or an ally lands crowd control, enter with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and a recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If your team needs to retreat, end Aurora R Between Worlds early and leave with them.

Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses walls to engage from long range and stun you. Stand away from walls, and when her hook attaches to one, look for an angle to interrupt her leap with the forced movement from Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Keep your distance while the empowered basic attack from Camille Q Precision Protocol is being prepared, and do not waste a response ability at the moment Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages.
Camille.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Camille's damage is mostly physical, so build armor first, but remember that armor cannot reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading immediately after the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates. Once it expires, open with Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in basic attacks. Create distance with the slow and backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding as you recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Do not readily use Aurora W Across the Veil to engage while Camille E Hookshot and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum are available.
Camille.laning: Stay away from walls and briefly harass Camille with Aurora Q Twofold Hex and basic attacks when she steps up to last-hit. Take control of the lane before she completes her first core item, but from mid game onward, do not leave the side lane Camille is in unattended for long.
Camille.combo: After Camille's engage ability is down, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration with basic attacks, lower her health with Aurora E The Weirding, then deal damage based on her missing health with the Aurora Q Twofold Hex recast.
Camille.escape: Your chance to counterattack comes immediately after you dodge the stun from Camille E Hookshot or interrupt her leap. If Camille has also used Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, move in while managing your distance with Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is still available, do not engage deeply just because Camille E Hookshot is down.
Camille.phase: In mid game, watch Camille's pressure on side-lane turrets. In late game, play toward Aurora's three-core-item power spike.
Camille.teamfight: Do not jump in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Camille E Hookshot and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum are available. After Camille uses an engage ability or an ally lands crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds, layer on the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, the damage and healing from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang increase while you are poisoned. Move out of range and fight again after the poison ends. You cannot use mobility abilities such as Aurora W Across the Veil or Aurora E The Weirding inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so do not step into the cloud. If you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn away to avoid the stun.
Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, Cassiopeia W Miasma, and Cassiopeia E Twin Fang all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor. If the healing from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang is a problem, add Morellonomicon after completing one core item. If the enemy team has a lot of crowd control that can lock down Aurora, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items.
Cassiopeia.fight: When Cassiopeia steps up to last-hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, build passive stacks with basic attacks, then recast it. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, retreat instead of taking repeated hits from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang while poisoned. After Cassiopeia uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere, close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil for a short trade.
Cassiopeia.laning: After pushing the wave, you can roam across terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Cassiopeia.combo: From a path clear of Cassiopeia W Miasma, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and approach with Aurora W Across the Veil. Weave in basic attacks to build passive stacks, then slow her and leap backward with Aurora E The Weirding. After lowering her health, recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn away instead of continuing to deal damage while facing her.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility skill, so immediately after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere is your chance to approach with Aurora W Across the Veil. Once Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is down, you can engage without worrying about its stun. If Cassiopeia W Miasma remains on your approach path, go around it rather than using a mobility ability over it.
Cassiopeia.phase: If you cannot build an early lead against Cassiopeia, she becomes strong in mid to late game, so farm safely until Aurora has three core items.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Enter with Aurora R Between Worlds after Cassiopeia uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere or the enemy's engage abilities are down. Inside its area, layer on the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding and recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex for damage. While Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is available, do not push forward while facing her.

Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets around the first target hit, so do not hide behind minions; move out of range. Reposition especially to avoid taking consecutive hits from the third missile. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of staying in front of him.
Corki.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki's main damage is physical, so build armor first. However, resistances cannot reduce the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions, and Corki E Gatling Gun reduces the effectiveness of the resistances you build while it hits you.
Corki.fight: When Corki steps up to last-hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in basic attacks to build passive stacks. Immediately after Corki W Valkyrie is down, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil to start a fight. If Corki engages with Corki W Valkyrie, slow him with Aurora E The Weirding while retreating.
Corki.laning: Pressure Corki so he cannot farm freely, then roam with Aurora W Across the Veil after pushing the wave.
Corki.combo: When Corki W Valkyrie is down, attack in this order: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Lowering his health with the basic attack and Aurora E The Weirding before the recast makes use of Aurora Q Twofold Hex's damage based on missing health. Aurora E The Weirding makes Aurora leap backward, so check the direction of your retreat.
Corki.escape: Immediately after Corki W Valkyrie is down is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil and land Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If Corki W Valkyrie is available, he can escape across terrain, so do not force your way too close.
Corki.phase: In mid game, disrupt Corki's farming and use Aurora W Across the Veil to affect other lanes. Corki grows stronger as he gets items, so do not let him scale freely; farm safely until Aurora has three core items.
Corki.teamfight: Do not jump in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Corki W Valkyrie is available. After Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie or an ally lands crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds, layer on the slow from Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If your team needs to retreat, end Aurora R Between Worlds early and leave with them.

Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with an auto attack, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate. Poke from outside its range and save Aurora W Across the Veil to respond. Disengage as Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up. If you have several stacks and low health, get completely out of Darius R Noxian Guillotine range.
Darius.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps. Build armor first against Darius's main damage, but armor cannot reduce the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine. If the healing from Darius Q Decimate is a problem, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Darius.fight: Take short trades just after Darius E Apprehend is used or Darius Q Decimate is used to clear minions. After the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, use an auto attack and Aurora E The Weirding to lower his health, then land the returning hit for damage based on his missing health and back away. Avoid long fights that let Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up.
Darius.laning: When Darius steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex from outside Darius E Apprehend range and weave in auto attacks to trigger passive healing. After pushing the wave, you can use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and roam.
Darius.combo: If Darius E Apprehend is down and you can secure the kill, attack in this order: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → Aurora W Across the Veil to close the gap → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → returning hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Check where Aurora E The Weirding will leap you backward before casting it, and use the returning hit after lowering Darius's health further but before the curse expires.
Darius.escape: Go in when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. If the kill is uncertain, do not engage first expecting Aurora W Across the Veil to reset.
Darius.phase: Repeat short trades in the mid game. In the late game, make use of your strength after completing three core items.
Darius.teamfight: Do not jump in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Darius E Apprehend or Darius R Noxian Guillotine is available. Once his engage ability is down or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, then deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the returning hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If you have Hemorrhage stacks and low health, back away so Darius R Noxian Guillotine cannot kill you and give him another cast.

Chogath.watch: Dodge sideways as soon as the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture appears under you, and save Aurora W Across the Veil for it. Hwei.phase: Grow safely early and play for your power spike after three core items.
Hwei.teamfight: Do not jump in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Hwei E Subject: Torment is available. Once Hwei has used his initiation spell or an ally applies crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds, then deal damage with the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recall of Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Irelia.watch: Irelia can dash through low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge, so back away as minions are about to die. Dodge the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you are trapped in the perimeter of Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Irelia deals mainly physical damage, and Aurora has low armor, so build armor first. Aurora's main magic damage works well against Irelia, whose magic resistance is relatively low.
Irelia.fight: When Irelia steps up to last-hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in a basic attack to trigger Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then back off. As Irelia dashes in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, slow her with Aurora E The Weirding and leap back. Right after Irelia Q Bladesurge is used, you have an opening to close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Irelia.laning: Do not leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and step back as minions are about to die. When Irelia steps forward to last-hit, take a short trade with Aurora Q Twofold Hex and a basic attack, using the healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. After pushing the wave, you can roam over terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Irelia.combo: Once Irelia Q Bladesurge is used, attack in this order: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → close in with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recall Aurora Q Twofold Hex. The recall damage scales with Irelia's missing health, so do not recall Aurora Q Twofold Hex immediately after the first hit. Before using Aurora E The Weirding, check the direction of your backward leap.
Irelia.escape: Right after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge, take advantage of her spent mobility spell to close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil. If the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet is also used, it is a good time to consider entering. If a kill is uncertain, check whether you will still have a way out before using Aurora W Across the Veil to enter.
Irelia.phase: Grow toward the point when Aurora has three core items and her win rate rises.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia because Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet can have a major impact on teamfights. Do not jump in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Irelia Q Bladesurge is available. Once Irelia's initiation spell is used or an ally applies crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds, then deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recall of Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Jayce.watch: When Jayce sets down a gate with Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast may follow. Sidestep out of its line. If Jayce leaps in with his hammer Q, watch for his E knockback; slow him with Aurora E The Weirding and retreat.
Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast deals physical damage, so magic resistance will not stop it. Movement speed also helps you leave its telegraphed area.
Jayce.fight: Right after Jayce uses the leap on Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil and fight.
Jayce.laning: After Aurora pushes the wave, she can cross terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil to reach another lane.
Jayce.combo: Once Jayce has used his leap, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil, and auto attack. Then slow him with Aurora E The Weirding as you leap back, and recast Q after his health has fallen further.
Jayce.escape: Right after Jayce leaps in with his hammer Q, Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, Aurora has an opening to engage. If Jayce has also used the knockback on Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate, close in with Aurora W Across the Veil and land Aurora Q Twofold Hex.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so Aurora should poke and farm safely. Play toward the point after three core items, when her win rate rises.
Jayce.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Jayce still has the leap on Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast. Once he has used it, or an ally has applied crowd control, create the area with R, layer the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Jax.watch: Jax Q Leap Strike lets him use minions to close the gap, so do not stand close to a minion wave. When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop auto attacking and retreat beyond its stun range. Save Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding to escape then.
Jax.build: Jax deals both physical and magic damage, so do not build only one type of resistance. If the enemy has a lot of immobilizing crowd control to catch Aurora, buy Zhonya's Hourglass between core items.
Jax.fight: Take a short trade after Jax E Counter Strike ends, and do not auto attack while it is active. If Jax approaches with Jax Q Leap Strike, create distance with the slow and backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding.
Jax.laning: When Jax E Counter Strike is unavailable, weave in auto attacks to build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then back off.
Jax.combo: If Jax E Counter Strike is unavailable, use this sequence: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Recast after your auto attack and Aurora E The Weirding have lowered his health, and check where you will land when you leap back.
Jax.escape: Right after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike, he has spent a way to close the gap. If Jax E Counter Strike is also unavailable, you can approach with Aurora W Across the Veil and land Aurora Q Twofold Hex.
Jax.phase: Keep in mind that Aurora’s win rate tends to rise once she has her three core items in the late game, and focus on scaling instead of forcing early kills.
Jax.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Jax Q Leap Strike is available. If Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and engages, avoid grouping up and dodge the stun. Once his engage abilities are unavailable or an ally has applied crowd control, create the area with Aurora R Between Worlds. Then layer the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

KSante.watch: If K'Sante has hit you repeatedly with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes or built stacks by hitting minions, watch for the next shockwave's pull and stun. While he charges K'Sante W Path Maker, he is unstoppable and takes reduced damage, so watch his charge direction and sidestep. Do not keep terrain behind you where K'Sante R All Out can push you over a wall.
KSante.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. K'Sante deals mainly physical damage and Aurora has low armor, so build armor first. If the enemy has a lot of crowd control to lock down Aurora, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items.
KSante.fight: When K'Sante steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration with auto attacks, then back off. If he comes in with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork, answer with the slow and backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding. When K'Sante R All Out is active, focus damage while his defenses are reduced, but do not take his increased damage and healing on your own.
KSante.laning: K'Sante is also weak at this point, so chip away at his health with short pokes whenever he steps up for a last hit. After pushing the wave, you can cross terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil to roam.
KSante.combo: To engage, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil, and weave in an auto attack. Then slow him with Aurora E The Weirding as you leap back, and recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. The recast damage scales with K'Sante's missing health, so do not recast immediately after the first hit.
KSante.escape: Do not go deep just because one of K'Sante W Path Maker, K'Sante E Footwork, or K'Sante R All Out is unavailable. Look for a window after his mobility and crowd control are spent, especially before K'Sante R All Out is ready again, to close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil. Use Aurora E The Weirding to slow K'Sante and retreat if he engages again.
KSante.phase: Early on, focus on safe poke and farming instead of forcing kills. Play toward Aurora's three core item point, when her win rate rises.
KSante.teamfight: Don’t engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while K'Sante W Path Maker, K'Sante E Footwork, and K'Sante R All Out are available. Once K'Sante has used his engage ability or an ally has applied crowd control, use Aurora R Between Worlds to create your zone, then deal damage with Aurora E The Weirding’s slow and Aurora Q Twofold Hex’s recast. If you expect a prolonged fight while K'Sante R All Out is active, make sure at least one teammate has a source of Grievous Wounds, and don’t let K'Sante hit multiple enemies alone.

Karma.watch: Repeated hits from Karma Q Inner Flame reduce the cooldown of Karma R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire, so avoid them from behind minions or outside its range. Leave the circle left by a Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra before its follow-up explosion. If Karma W Focused Resolve links to you, break it by moving away before the root; if it is empowered, account for Karma healing during the link.
Karma.build: Karma's main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance. If the healing from Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra prevents you from securing a kill, build Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Karma.fight: When Karma steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in auto attacks, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex after her health has fallen. Approach with Aurora W Across the Veil after Karma W Focused Resolve is unavailable and the shield from Karma E Inspire has expired.
Karma.laning: After pushing the wave, cross terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil to reach another lane.
Karma.combo: Once Karma W Focused Resolve is unavailable and the shield from Karma E Inspire has expired, use this sequence: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration with auto attacks, and recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex from where Aurora E The Weirding's backward leap leaves you.
Karma.escape: Karma has no mobility ability to create distance herself, so an unavailable Karma W Focused Resolve is your chance to close in with Aurora W Across the Veil. If the shield from Karma E Inspire or Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra is active, wait until it expires before engaging. If a kill is uncertain, do not engage first expecting the cooldown of Aurora W Across the Veil to reset.
Karma.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after she completes three core items, so focus on steady play instead of forcing kills until then.
Karma.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Karma W Focused Resolve is available. If Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra has shielded nearby allies, wait for the shields to expire. After Karma has used her way to prevent your escape or an ally has applied crowd control, engage with Aurora R Between Worlds, then follow with the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield absorbs Aurora's magic poke, so deal damage while it is down. When Kassadin enters with R Riftwalk, use Aurora E The Weirding to slow him and leap back to create distance. Kassadin E Force Pulse slows, and its cooldown decreases whenever abilities are used nearby, so avoid unnecessary casts.
Kassadin.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Kassadin Q Null Sphere, W Nether Blade, and E Force Pulse. Armor and healing reduction are inefficient against Kassadin, so do not buy them first.
Kassadin.fight: When Kassadin steps up to last-hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in basic attacks to build Aurora P Spirit Abjuration stacks. Once the shield from Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, lower his health further with Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex for its damage based on missing health.
Kassadin.laning: Before Kassadin learns R Riftwalk, push waves to keep him at his turret and pressure him with your jungler to build a level and CS lead. When clearing waves, avoid unnecessary ability casts near Kassadin.
Kassadin.combo: When the shield from Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down and Kassadin R Riftwalk is unavailable, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Even after leaping back with Aurora E The Weirding, keep Kassadin in the return path to land the second hit.
Kassadin.escape: Aurora's window to engage is before Kassadin learns R Riftwalk or just after he uses it. When the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse is down and he has no shield from Kassadin Q Null Sphere, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil to start a trade. Unless the kill is certain, do not go too deep with Aurora W Across the Veil; save Aurora E The Weirding for a second engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Kassadin.phase: From mid game onward, Kassadin can engage with R Riftwalk, so fight while it is down. Late game, he can enter the backline and escape, so do not stand alone. Keep poking and farming safely until Aurora has three core items.
Kassadin.teamfight: Do not lead with Aurora R Between Worlds while Kassadin R Riftwalk is available. After Kassadin engages or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, then follow the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding with a recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Do not stand alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk.

Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces magic resistance and armor, so avoid a direct hit. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on missing health, so take extra care when low. When Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, hold your damage until the invulnerability ends.
Kayle.build: After completing your first core item, buy Morellonomicon to counter the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Against Kayle's listed damage, build magic resistance before armor, and dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast so it cannot reduce your resistances.
Kayle.laning: When Kayle steps up to last-hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, lower her health with basic attacks, then recast it. Use the healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration to repeat short trades.
Kayle.combo: Start with the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil, land a basic attack and Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If Kayle R Divine Judgment makes her invulnerable, hold the recast and look to land it after the invulnerability ends.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no dash, but Kayle W Celestial Blessing can increase her movement speed, so engage when you have dodged the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast. If Kayle has already used R Divine Judgment, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil and look for a chance to land Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Unless the kill is certain, do not go deep expecting Aurora W Across the Veil to reset.
Kayle.teamfight: Find a path to Kayle from the side or out of vision so she has no time to attack from behind, and time your engage with allied crowd control. After the enemy uses its engage ability, enter with Aurora R Between Worlds, layer the slow from Aurora E The Weirding, and recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, use crowd control to wait out the invulnerability instead of concentrating damage into it, then attack.

Katarina.watch: When Katarina Q Bouncing Blade hits you, its dagger lands behind you; do not retreat blindly onto it. Avoid daggers on the ground. If Katarina enters with E Shunpo, use the slow and backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding to create distance. Katarina R Death Lotus deals heavy damage and applies healing reduction, so interrupt it as it starts with the forced movement from Aurora Q Twofold Hex.
Katarina.build: Build magic resistance and health first against Katarina's main damage. Katarina R Death Lotus also deals some physical damage and applies healing reduction, so do not rely on magic resistance or healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration alone to survive it.
Katarina.fight: When Katarina steps forward to last-hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in basic attacks to trigger Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. Do not recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex immediately; lower her health further with basic attacks or Aurora E The Weirding first. When Katarina E Shunpo is down and she cannot pick up a dagger, close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil to pressure her.
Katarina.laning: If Katarina Q Bouncing Blade hits you, watch where the dagger will land behind you and avoid fighting near it. After pushing the wave, roam using the leap and stealth from Aurora W Across the Veil.
Katarina.escape: Just after Katarina uses E Shunpo on something other than a dagger is a chance to engage with Aurora W Across the Veil. Picking up a dagger reduces the cooldown of Katarina E Shunpo, so engage while avoiding ground daggers or blocking access to them. Unless the kill is certain, do not force an engage expecting Aurora W Across the Veil to reset.
Katarina.phase: Late game, play teamfights around Aurora's rising win rate after she completes three core items.
Katarina.teamfight: Keep Katarina's dagger locations clear with your team and protect low-health allies to deny her first kill. After Katarina E Shunpo is down or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, then deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and a recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Watch for a chance to use the forced movement from Aurora Q Twofold Hex against Katarina R Death Lotus.

Kennen.watch: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken hits only the first target, so stand behind minions to avoid it. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm reaches two stacks, back off to avoid the third mark and stun. In teamfights, spread out from allies to avoid the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom.
Kennen.build: Build magic resistance before armor against Kennen's damage. Consider Quicksilver Sash if the stun from Kennen P Mark of the Storm is a threat. If Aurora is often caught by immobilizing crowd control, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items.
Kennen.fight: When Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, start a trade with Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Build Aurora P Spirit Abjuration stacks with basic attacks, then slow him with Aurora E The Weirding and back away. Recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex after lowering Kennen's health further.
Kennen.laning: When Kennen steps up to last-hit, take a short trade with Aurora Q Twofold Hex and basic attacks. Back off if Kennen P Mark of the Storm reaches two stacks. After pushing the wave, you can roam by using Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain.
Kennen.combo: After Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Aurora E The Weirding leaps opposite the cast direction, so check where you will land before using it.
Kennen.escape: Engage when Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and his Kennen P Mark of the Storm stacks have expired. Unless the kill is certain, do not engage with Aurora W Across the Veil expecting its cooldown to reset. If he counterattacks, slow him with Aurora E The Weirding and create distance.
Kennen.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after three core items, so prioritize safe poke and farming over risky early kills.
Kennen.teamfight: While Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom is available, spread out from allies and do not lead with Aurora R Between Worlds. After Kennen uses his engage ability, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and a recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If your team needs to retreat, end Aurora R Between Worlds early and leave with them.

Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, use Aurora E The Weirding to create distance before it pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, its fourth basic attack deals damage based on maximum health, so do not stay close enough to take all four hits. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can start from far away and out of vision, so watch your flank vision.
Kled.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Kled’s main damage is physical, and Aurora has low armor, so build armor first. Kled W Violent Tendencies and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on the target’s maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Kled.fight: When Kled steps up to last-hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in a basic attack to trigger Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then back off. Recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex after lowering his health further, but line up its return path before it expires. If Kled uses E Jousting to engage, slow him with Aurora E The Weirding and leap back.
Kled.laning: Take short trades to get healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. If you dismount Kled, push him away from the wave so he cannot build Courage by killing minions. If you cannot stop him before his Courage fills, create distance.
Kled.combo: After Kled's engage abilities are down, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → Aurora W Across the Veil to approach → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Use the basic attack to build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, and line up the return path of Aurora Q Twofold Hex even after Aurora E The Weirding leaps you backward. Be cautious about approaching first with Aurora W Across the Veil unless the kill is certain.
Kled.escape: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, create distance with Aurora E The Weirding or Aurora W Across the Veil before the pull triggers. When moving in to attack, do not assume you are safe just because Kled E Jousting is down; check that Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is also still on cooldown.
Kled.phase: Early on, prioritize safe poke and farming so Kled gains no advantage. Kled weakens after lane and mid game, while Aurora's win rate rises after three core items, so scale steadily to that point instead of forcing early kills.
Kled.teamfight: Maintain flank vision against Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. If you cannot stop it, position so your frontline takes the initial charge. Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are available. After Kled uses his engage abilities or an ally lands crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the return of Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Leblanc.watch: While the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice remains, her next ability will deal more damage. Back off until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, or Aurora R Between Worlds to move out of chain range before it roots you.
Leblanc.build: LeBlanc's main ability damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. When building further defenses, also consider a spell shield against her opening ability and movement speed to leave a telegraphed area.
Leblanc.fight: When LeBlanc steps up to last-hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in a basic attack to build passive stacks. If LeBlanc enters with W Distortion, slow her with Aurora E The Weirding while backing away. Move in after her return expires or is used.
Leblanc.laning: After pushing the wave, you can roam with Aurora W Across the Veil. Tell your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from mid vision.
Leblanc.combo: After LeBlanc W Distortion's return expires or is used, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → Aurora W Across the Veil to approach → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. The return damage of Aurora Q Twofold Hex scales with the target's missing health, so use it after lowering her health with the basic attack and Aurora E The Weirding, rather than immediately after the first hit.
Leblanc.escape: Aurora has an opening when LeBlanc W Distortion is down and its return has expired or been used. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is also down, close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil and land Aurora Q Twofold Hex.
Leblanc.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after three core items, so prioritize safe poke and farming until then.
Leblanc.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while LeBlanc W Distortion is available. After LeBlanc uses her engage ability or an ally lands crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the return of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If taking part in an enemy champion kill resets the cooldown of Aurora W Across the Veil, use it for your next move.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard passes through allied minions after hitting them, so do not stand in line with the minions. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost roots you or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb stuns you, escaping with Aurora W Across the Veil or Aurora E The Weirding is difficult. Do not move in recklessly while those abilities are available. If Lissandra uses R Frozen Tomb on herself, she becomes immune to damage, so save your finishing damage until afterward.
Lissandra.build: Lissandra's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance over armor. If you frequently die while caught by Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items. If the healing from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb prevents you from securing kills, consider Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Lissandra.fight: Take a short trade right after Lissandra uses W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. Once she has also used Lissandra E Glacial Path, she has no escape, so look for a chance to close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil and land Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is still available, do not commit all your damage at once.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle to your allied minions to avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard after it passes through them. When Lissandra steps up to last-hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in a basic attack to get healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then back off. After pushing the wave, you can roam over terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Lissandra.combo: If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down, start with the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil, and weave in a basic attack. Then slow her with Aurora E The Weirding while leaping back, and recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Its return damage scales with missing health, so do not recast immediately after the first hit.
Lissandra.escape: The moment after Lissandra recasts E Glacial Path to move is an opening to engage. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil to trade. If Lissandra engages with E Glacial Path instead, hit her with Aurora E The Weirding to slow her and leap back to create distance.
Lissandra.phase: From there, play to scale steadily until you have three core items.
Lissandra.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Lissandra E Glacial Path is available. After Lissandra uses E Glacial Path or an ally lands crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal damage with the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the return of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If your team needs to retreat, end Aurora R Between Worlds early and leave with them.

Lux.watch: Getting hit by Lux Q Light Binding makes it easy for her to land follow-up abilities, so bait out and dodge it before approaching. Do not stand in line with an ally, and dodge sideways when you see the red targeting line of Lux R Final Spark.
Lux.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor. Also consider movement speed so you can leave the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Lux.fight: When Lux steps up to last-hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in a basic attack to build passive stacks. After Lux Q Light Binding misses, close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil, then slow her with Aurora E The Weirding while backing away.
Lux.laning: If a Lux ability hits you, leave her basic attack range so she cannot trigger the Lux P Illumination mark with a basic attack. After pushing the wave, you can roam over terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → Aurora W Across the Veil to approach → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Do not recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex immediately; lower her health with the basic attack and Aurora E The Weirding first.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility ability, so a missed Lux Q Light Binding is your opening to engage. Approach from the side with Aurora W Across the Veil, but do not force the engage hoping for its cooldown reset unless the kill is certain.
Lux.phase: Farm safely early, aiming to reach three core items.
Lux.teamfight: Do not group with allies and approach from one direction where Lux E Lucent Singularity can hinder you all. After Lux Q Light Binding is down or an ally lands crowd control, engage with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the return of Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Malphite.watch: Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash that knocks up multiple targets, so do not group near walls or bushes when he is out of sight. Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you on hit, so do not start a trade immediately afterward.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, Malphite E Ground Slam, and Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Fight Malphite with Aurora's primary magic damage and the maximum health damage from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield before trading, when you can damage his actual health. After Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil and weave in basic attacks to trigger Aurora P Spirit Abjuration.
Malphite.laning: Hit Malphite with Aurora Q Twofold Hex when he steps up for a last hit and weave in basic attacks, but do not stay within range of Malphite Q Seismic Shard for long.
Malphite.combo: After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. The recast damage scales with missing health, so do not recast immediately after the first hit.
Malphite.escape: The window after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down is Aurora's chance to engage. Close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil or Aurora R Between Worlds, then land Aurora Q Twofold Hex.
Malphite.phase: Look for Aurora's stronger win rate once she has three core items.
Malphite.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force cannot knock up multiple people, and do not dive in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while it is available. After Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Malzahar.watch: If Malzahar Q Call of the Void silences you, you cannot use your engage abilities. When you see it cast, move outside the line between its two portals. The suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp cannot be broken by Aurora W Across the Veil or a shield, so do not enter an unwarded area alone while Malzahar can use it.
Malzahar.build: Build magic resistance first against Malzahar's primary damage. Malzahar R Nether Grasp deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health increase alone. If you need an answer to the suppression, get Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it with Aurora Q Twofold Hex before fighting. When Malzahar steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in basic attacks to build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. Lower his health further before recasting Aurora Q Twofold Hex. The window after Malzahar Q Call of the Void is down and when there are no voidlings is your chance to engage.
Malzahar.laning: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect spreads to a nearby enemy, so do not wait beside that minion to last hit. If Malzahar pushes up, remove Malzahar P Void Shift with Aurora Q Twofold Hex and pressure him with your jungler. After pushing the wave, you can roam across terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Malzahar.combo: Remove Malzahar P Void Shift with the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, then approach with Aurora W Across the Veil. Build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration with basic attacks, use Aurora E The Weirding to deal damage and slow him while retreating, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. The recast damage scales with the target's missing health, so do not recast immediately after the first hit.
Malzahar.escape: Engage when Malzahar Q Call of the Void is down and Malzahar P Void Shift has been removed. Malzahar has no mobility ability to create distance, but remember that engaging with Aurora W Across the Veil cannot break the suppression if Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available.
Malzahar.phase: Malzahar grows stronger over time, so limit his chances to build up early. Later, farm safely until Aurora has three core items.
Malzahar.teamfight: If Malzahar W Void Swarm has spawned voidlings, clear them first with an area ability such as Aurora E The Weirding. Engage with Aurora R Between Worlds after Malzahar's engage ability is down or an ally lands crowd control, then deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp suppresses an ally, an ally must interrupt its channel with crowd control that prevents movement.

Mel.watch: Mel W Rebuttal reflects projectiles, so bait it out before using Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Dodge Mel E Solar Snare sideways to avoid being rooted by its center. If you have already been hit several times, watch for the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance even if you still have health. While Overwhelm stacks remain, Mel R Golden Eclipse can hit you from far away, so wait somewhere safe.
Mel.build: Get magic resistance first against Mel's damage. Also consider movement speed to leave the telegraphed area, and enough health to stay outside her execute range.
Mel.fight: Dodge Mel E Solar Snare sideways and bait out Mel W Rebuttal, then close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil. Mel has no mobility ability, so weave in basic attacks when you reach her to trigger Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. Lower her health before recasting Aurora Q Twofold Hex.
Mel.combo: Bait out Mel W Rebuttal first, then use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Aurora E The Weirding leaps backward, so check the direction of your retreat.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility ability, so dodge the root from Mel E Solar Snare and engage while Mel W Rebuttal is down. If the kill is not certain, do not force an engage with Aurora W Across the Veil; use the backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding to create distance.
Mel.phase: Mel grows stronger over time, so slow her growth early. Farm steadily until Aurora has three core items.
Mel.teamfight: After an enemy engage ability is down or an ally lands crowd control, use Aurora R Between Worlds to restrict Mel's movement. Follow with the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding and recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If Mel W Rebuttal is still available, be careful with projectiles. End Aurora R Between Worlds early when your allies need to retreat.

Naafiri.watch: If the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers makes you bleed, keep your distance until the bleed ends so the second hit misses. Naafiri E Eviscerate revives her packmates, so stay alert even just after clearing them. Do not travel alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is ready.
Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals mostly physical damage and Aurora has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. If healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate makes duels last longer, get Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Naafiri.fight: When Naafiri steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, lower her health with basic attacks, then recast it. If she engages with Naafiri E Eviscerate or Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit, slow her with Aurora E The Weirding and leap backward to create distance. Do not close in first with Aurora W Across the Veil unless the kill is certain.
Naafiri.laning: Harass and farm from behind your minion line using your range advantage, and do not give Naafiri an opening to close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate. If you push the wave, you can roam with Aurora W Across the Veil, but keep wide vision against Naafiri's midgame roams.
Naafiri.combo: After Naafiri's engage ability is down, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Lower her health with the basic attack and Aurora E The Weirding before recasting Aurora Q Twofold Hex to make use of its missing health damage. First check that the backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding will take you somewhere safe.
Naafiri.escape: Do not engage just because either Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or Naafiri E Eviscerate is down. Once Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is also down and she has fewer ways to move, close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil and land Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Naafiri cannot be targeted during the brief period when Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, so finish her after it ends.
Naafiri.phase: Later in the game, stay grouped with allies to avoid getting picked off, and take a front-to-back teamfight.
Naafiri.teamfight: Do not dive in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Naafiri's engage abilities are available. After Naafiri's engage ability is down or an ally lands crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Immediately after an ally dies, watch for Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit again and retreat together.

Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise can easily hit you in succession. Keep your distance in front of him, and use Aurora E The Weirding to retreat as he pulls you. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after hitting three times, so trade briefly and back off. While Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don’t go in alone where your allies can’t help you.
Mordekaiser.build: Build magic resistance first against Mordekaiser's main ability damage. If the healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible is a problem, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item. Account for his basic attack damage too, but avoid stacking only health because Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise scales with maximum health.
Mordekaiser.fight: When Mordekaiser steps up for a last hit, trade briefly with the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and a basic attack, then back off before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. Commit your damage after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down and the shield from Mordekaiser W Indestructible has worn off or been converted into healing. Be careful about using Aurora W Across the Veil to engage unless the kill is certain.
Mordekaiser.laning: When Mordekaiser steps forward for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in a basic attack to get healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then back off. After pushing the wave, you can cross terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil to influence another lane.
Mordekaiser.combo: When Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down and you can engage, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Check the direction of your backward leap when using Aurora E The Weirding.
Mordekaiser.escape: Engage while Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down. If you risk being pulled again, use the slow and backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding to create distance. Mordekaiser has no mobility ability, so he struggles to close the gap again once you create it. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, do not enter its range alone.
Mordekaiser.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after she completes three core items, so prioritize safe poke and farming until then.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Keep some space between yourself and allies so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp cannot pull several of you together. After the enemy's engage ability is down or an ally lands crowd control, enter with Aurora R Between Worlds to create its area, then deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Stay where Mordekaiser cannot catch you. If your team needs to retreat, end Aurora R Between Worlds early and leave with them.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting a target, so do not stand on top of an ally. A disguised Neeko can hide the windup of Neeko R Pop Blossom; spread out early if a suspicious opponent approaches. Do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter. Watch where the real Neeko is.
Neeko.build: Neeko's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If being rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs lets her follow with Neeko R Pop Blossom and kill you, prioritize tenacity. If the enemy has enough immobilizing crowd control to prevent you from using Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items.
Neeko.fight: Trade right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used or while Neeko R Pop Blossom is down. After landing the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, lower her health with basic attacks and Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If she comes in with Neeko R Pop Blossom, counter with the slow and backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding to create distance.
Neeko.laning: When Neeko steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in a basic attack to get healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then back off. After pushing the wave, you can cross terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil to roam.
Neeko.combo: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration with the basic attack, leap backward with Aurora E The Weirding to create distance, then deal recast damage that scales with her missing health.
Neeko.escape: Once Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil and start a trade with Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Aurora W Across the Veil resets only if you participate in a kill, so be careful about using it to engage when a kill is uncertain.
Neeko.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after she completes three core items, so use safe poke and farming early to reach that point.
Neeko.teamfight: Do not jump in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Neeko R Pop Blossom is available. After Neeko's engage is down or an ally lands crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds, then deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike becomes more threatening as its stacks grow, so poke him when he steps up for a last hit. If you are alone within range and affected by Nasus W Wither, escaping is difficult; do not move within its range alone. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid fighting and wait out its duration unless you have a clear numbers or damage advantage.
Nasus.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main damage source. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor while you stand in it, so leave the area.
Nasus.fight: Look to engage when Nasus W Wither is down and Nasus R Fury of the Sands is inactive.
Nasus.laning: Do not keep pushing the lane and let Nasus stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike freely under his turret. Let the wave come toward you, poke him when he steps up for last hits, and call for a jungle gank.
Nasus.combo: When you have an opening to engage, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration with the basic attack, then use the slow and backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding to create distance from Nasus. The recast damage scales with his missing health, so do not recast immediately after the first hit.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no ability to create distance himself, so a used Nasus W Wither gives you an opening to enter with Aurora W Across the Veil. Delay the engage if Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active. If you have let him get close, use the slow and backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding to create distance.
Nasus.phase: Stacks of Nasus Q Siphoning Strike are permanent, making the matchup worse over time, so limit his chances to last hit from the early game.
Nasus.teamfight: Keep your distance and attack Nasus instead of meeting him head-on. After absorbing his engage, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds, apply the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, wait out the fight unless you have a clear numbers or damage advantage.

Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows, helping him close in. Move to the side opposite where the axe lands to stop him from retrieving it. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, movement impairments do not work, so create distance and do not stay close enough to take true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Olaf.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Olaf's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Armor cannot reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, so health and spacing also matter.
Olaf.fight: When Olaf steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in a basic attack to trigger Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. Slow him with Aurora E The Weirding while leaping backward, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex against the damaged Olaf. Olaf gets stronger as his health falls, so do not force a close fight just because he is at half health.
Olaf.laning: Move opposite the landing spot of Olaf Q Undertow to stop him from retrieving the axe, and poke briefly when he steps up for a last hit. After pushing the wave, you can cross terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil to roam.
