Olaf.combo: If preventing Olaf from retrieving his axe has lengthened his path toward you, attack with the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration with the basic attack, then deal the recast damage after creating distance with the backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding. Do not use this combo to stay close and keep fighting while Olaf R Ragnarok is active.
Olaf.escape: A missed Olaf Q Undertow that Olaf cannot retrieve is an opening to engage. Olaf has no ability to create distance himself, so close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil after Olaf R Ragnarok ends and use Aurora E The Weirding to secure an escape route.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so poke and farm safely without giving up kills. Olaf becomes relatively weaker later, while Aurora grows strong after completing three core items. Focus on getting through the early game safely.
Olaf.teamfight: Do not jump in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Olaf R Ragnarok is active or the enemy still has a way to engage. Create the area after the enemy's engage is down or an ally lands crowd control, then deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If your team needs to retreat, end the area early and leave with them.

Orianna.watch: Orianna R Command: Shockwave pulls enemies toward the ball, so watch the ball’s position rather than Orianna’s to dodge it. If the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance is troublesome, use Aurora E The Weirding to deal damage and leap backward to create distance.
Orianna.build: Orianna’s main damage is magic damage, so consider magic resistance first. Movement speed also helps you leave the area Orianna has placed.
Orianna.fight: The moment after Orianna Q Command: Attack sends the ball away from her is a chance to trade. Land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, then use a basic attack and Aurora E The Weirding to lower her health before recasting Aurora Q Twofold Hex.
Orianna.combo: When Orianna Q Command: Attack sends the ball away, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and approach with Aurora W Across the Veil. Weave in a basic attack, then use Aurora E The Weirding to slow her and leap backward. Recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex last.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no mobility ability, so check the ball’s position and engage during the window after Orianna R Command: Shockwave is used. If a kill is not certain, do not enter with Aurora W Across the Veil assuming you can rely on a cooldown reset to escape.
Orianna.phase: In the mid game, keep poking and farming safely, then look for Aurora’s power spike after completing three core items.
Orianna.teamfight: Position away from Orianna’s ball to avoid Orianna R Command: Shockwave. After that ability is used or an ally applies crowd control, enter with Aurora R Between Worlds to trap enemies, then deal damage with the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns you, so stay outside its range. Keeping minions between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear can reduce its poke damage. When you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.
Pantheon.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pantheon’s main damage is physical and Aurora has low armor, so build armor first. If the enemy team has a lot of crowd control that can lock Aurora down, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items.
Pantheon.fight: When Pantheon steps up to last-hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in basic attacks to build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. As Pantheon W Shield Vault comes in, use Aurora E The Weirding to slow him and leap backward to create distance. During Pantheon E Aegis Assault, wait for it to end before attacking from the front, or move to his side for an angle.
Pantheon.laning: Keep minions between you and Pantheon during Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke. When he steps up to last-hit, attack briefly to make use of the healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. After pushing the wave, you can roam over terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Pantheon.combo: When Pantheon W Shield Vault is used and you can engage, use this sequence: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait for it to end instead of dealing damage from the front, or move to his side for an angle.
Pantheon.escape: Look to engage after Pantheon W Shield Vault is used, especially before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again. If only Pantheon W Shield Vault is used, he can escape with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, so check both abilities. If a kill is not certain, save Aurora W Across the Veil to escape instead of using it to engage.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s impact falls off as the game goes late, so farm safely and aim for the point when Aurora has three core items.
Pantheon.teamfight: Do not initiate with Aurora R Between Worlds while Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available. After Pantheon’s initiation abilities are used or an ally applies crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. When you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.

Ornn.watch: Stay away from the pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and from walls. Ornn E Searing Charge knocks you up if it hits a pillar or terrain, so when you see the charge, retreat toward open space and check the direction of Aurora E The Weirding’s backward leap. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, keep your distance until the effect expires.
Ornn.fight: When Ornn steps up to last-hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, lower his health with a basic attack and Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Weave in basic attacks to build stacks and get healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, keeping the trade short. If Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God is available, be cautious about using Aurora W Across the Veil to engage deep.
Ornn.laning: When Ornn steps forward to last-hit, trade with Aurora Q Twofold Hex and avoid the area around the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture. If Ornn tries to craft an item, attack him to interrupt the crafting. After pushing the wave, you can roam with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Ornn.combo: When Ornn’s engage tools are used, attack in this order: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration with basic attacks, create distance with Aurora E The Weirding’s backward leap, then deal recast damage with Aurora Q Twofold Hex based on missing health. When Ornn E Searing Charge comes in, slow him with Aurora E The Weirding and retreat.
Ornn.escape: Do not immediately engage deep just because Ornn E Searing Charge has been used; check Ornn R Call of the Forge God too. The window before Ornn R Call of the Forge God is available again is an especially good time to engage, and you can close the distance then with Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, and Aurora R Between Worlds.
Ornn.phase: Aurora’s win rate rises after she completes three core items, while Ornn gains items and upgrades for his allies’ Masterwork items. Build an early lead and pressure to end the game before those upgrades accumulate.
Ornn.teamfight: Do not initiate with Aurora R Between Worlds while Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are available. Dodge the elemental summoned by Ornn R Call of the Forge God by moving sideways, and leave the straight line between the elemental and Ornn, along which he can send it back. After Ornn’s engage tools are used or an ally applies crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can root with the river element, so if she approaches holding that element, retreat outside its range. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can explode and stun when it hits a wall, so do not put a wall behind you, and avoid the river and narrow passages.
Qiyana.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. The main damage from Qiyana P Royal Privilege, Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, and Qiyana E Audacity is physical, so build armor first. If the enemy has a lot of crowd control that prevents movement, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items.
Qiyana.fight: Do not approach first with Aurora W Across the Veil while Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are available. As Qiyana comes in, slow her with Aurora E The Weirding and leap backward. If she remains in front of you after using her mobility abilities, counterattack.
Qiyana.laning: When Qiyana steps forward to last-hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in basic attacks to build passive stacks, then back off after a short trade. After pushing the wave, you can roam over terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Qiyana.combo: Build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration with basic attacks, leap backward with Aurora E The Weirding to create distance, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex.
Qiyana.escape: Do not rush an engage when only Qiyana W Terrashape has been used, since she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity. In particular, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil before Qiyana E Audacity is available again, after avoiding her mobility abilities and crowd control. If Qiyana can still counterattack, use Aurora E The Weirding to create distance.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so avoid giving her an advantage in the early and mid game and build armor. Her strength falls off relatively in the late game, while Aurora’s win rate rises after completing three core items, so scale safely until then.
Qiyana.teamfight: Do not initiate with Aurora R Between Worlds while Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are available. After Qiyana’s engage tools are used or an ally applies crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Even when grouped with allies, stay away from terrain to avoid getting caught by Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.

Poppy.build: Poppy deals mostly physical damage, and Aurora has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Poppy.fight: Right after Poppy E Heroic Charge is used is your chance to close the gap. Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, lower her health with basic attacks and Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. When Poppy engages, you can counter with Aurora E The Weirding and leap back. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, walk away instead of relying on the leap.
Poppy.laning: When Poppy steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in a basic attack to get healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then back off. Remove the shield dropped by Poppy P Iron Ambassador if you can safely step on it first, and avoid standing with a wall behind you in case Poppy uses Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy E Heroic Charge is used and Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, use this sequence: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Build stacks of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration with basic attacks and use the backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding to create distance. Recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex after lowering her health further.
Poppy.escape: Right after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge, there is a window when her mobility is unavailable. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, you can engage with Aurora W Across the Veil or Aurora R Between Worlds. If the kill is uncertain, do not jump in first expecting a cooldown reset on Aurora W Across the Veil.
Poppy.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after three core items, so prioritize safe poke and farming until then.

Quinn.watch: When marked by Quinn P Harrier, move out of basic attack range before her empowered attack lands. Stay behind the minion line so minions take Quinn Q Blinding Assault first. If your vision is reduced, do not throw skillshots during that time. Quinn E Vault knocks Aurora back and leaves a mark, so slow Quinn with Aurora E The Weirding as she comes in and create distance.
Quinn.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Quinn's physical damage early. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and build armor first.
Quinn.fight: Do not force a close fight while Quinn E Vault is available. Right after Quinn uses Quinn E Vault, close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil and land Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Before recasting Aurora Q Twofold Hex, lower her health further with basic attacks or Aurora E The Weirding.
Quinn.laning: When Quinn has no Quinn P Harrier mark and steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in a basic attack for a short trade.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is used, attack in this order: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. The recast damage scales with the target's missing health, so do not use it immediately after the first hit.
Quinn.escape: Your window to engage is right after Quinn E Vault is used. Until then, do not use Aurora W Across the Veil to close the gap first. When Quinn uses Quinn E Vault on you, counter with Aurora E The Weirding and back away. If the kill is uncertain, do not go deep expecting a cooldown reset on Aurora W Across the Veil.
Quinn.phase: Aurora is weak early, and Quinn's marked basic attacks are threatening, so prioritize safe poke and farming. In the midgame, watch for Quinn roaming with Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines. Push the wave before joining your team with Aurora W Across the Veil. Aurora's win rate rises after three core items, so aim for steady growth until then instead of forcing kills.
Quinn.teamfight: Do not jump in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Quinn E Vault is available. After Quinn uses Quinn E Vault or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, then follow with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and a recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

Renekton.watch: Keep your distance when Renekton P Reign of Anger is over or near half full, as he can use empowered abilities in succession. The first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice enables a second dash if it hits a unit, so do not stand in or behind a group of minions.
Renekton.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Renekton deals mostly physical damage, and Aurora has low armor, so build armor first. An empowered recast of Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces your armor, so position yourself to dodge that dash too.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton's Fury is empty or after he has used Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. If he engages with Renekton E Slice and Dice, slow him with Aurora E The Weirding and leap back to create distance. If Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage, close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil and counterattack.
Renekton.laning: When Renekton steps up to hit a minion, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in a basic attack, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. After pushing the wave, you can roam across terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Renekton.combo: When Renekton E Slice and Dice is used and his Fury is low, use this sequence: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Lower his health with the basic attack and Aurora E The Weirding before recasting Aurora Q Twofold Hex to make use of its missing-health damage. Even after leaping back with Aurora E The Weirding, line up the recast path of Aurora Q Twofold Hex to hit him.
Renekton.escape: Do not engage first if Renekton E Slice and Dice is available and you are close enough to be stunned by Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Right after you make Renekton use Renekton E Slice and Dice is your window to close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil. After engaging, use Aurora E The Weirding to retreat.
Renekton.phase: Renekton's value falls if you grow through the midgame without giving him kills. Poke safely and grow toward Aurora's win-rate rise after three core items.
Renekton.teamfight: Do not jump in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Renekton E Slice and Dice is available. After he uses that dash or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and a recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If your team needs to retreat, end Aurora R Between Worlds early and leave with them.

Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter is dangerous while you stay close to him, so keep your distance. If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits, create distance with Aurora W Across the Veil or Aurora E The Weirding before the second shot arrives. Watch for the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer too.
Rumble.build: If you need a defensive item, choose one with magic resistance first. Rumble deals mostly magic damage, including damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only health.
Rumble.fight: When Rumble steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in a basic attack for a short trade. If the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, wait briefly before dealing damage, and do not stay in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter for long.
Rumble.laning: After pushing the wave, you can roam across terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Rumble.combo: If you dodge Rumble E Electro Harpoon and the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield expires, attack in this order: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Lower his health with the basic attack and Aurora E The Weirding before recasting Aurora Q Twofold Hex to increase its missing-health damage.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so your chance to engage comes after both shots of Rumble E Electro Harpoon are used and the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield expires. Approach with Aurora W Across the Veil. If a takedown is unlikely to reset its cooldown, engage with an escape option in mind.
Rumble.phase: Grow steadily until Aurora's win rate rises after three core items.
Rumble.teamfight: Engage with Aurora R Between Worlds after the enemy's initiation ability is used or an ally lands crowd control. Inside the zone, apply the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding and recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If your team needs to retreat, end Aurora R Between Worlds early and leave with them.

Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, the follow-up Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root and Ryze Q Overload deals more damage. If you have the E mark, move away from allies and keep your distance until it expires. Ryze R Realm Warp takes time to activate, so watch where it is cast and where it will arrive.
Ryze.build: Ryze deals mainly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Consider movement speed to get out of telegraphed attack areas. The source gives no specific item purchases, so no items are specified.
Ryze.fight: When Ryze steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in an auto attack to trigger Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. If you dodged Ryze E Spell Flux or Ryze R Realm Warp is down, use Aurora W Across the Veil to close the gap. As Ryze comes in, slow him with Aurora E The Weirding and leap backward to create distance.
Ryze.laning: Ryze also lacks mana and damage early, so take short trades when he steps up for last hits to pressure his growth. After pushing the wave, use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and roam.
Ryze.combo: Land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, then approach with Aurora W Across the Veil and weave in an auto attack. Follow with Aurora E The Weirding for damage and a slow, leap backward, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. The recast damage scales with the target's missing health, so do not recast immediately after the first hit.
Ryze.escape: While Ryze R Realm Warp is down, Ryze has no mobility tool, giving you a chance to approach with Aurora W Across the Veil. If you dodged Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison slows instead of rooting, making it less risky to go in. After entering with Aurora W Across the Veil, if the kill is not certain, do not rely on a reset; use Aurora E The Weirding to secure a way out.
Ryze.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after three core items, so focus on farming and safe pressure through the early and mid game instead of forcing kills.
Ryze.teamfight: Do not lead with Aurora R Between Worlds while Ryze R Realm Warp is available. After Ryze has committed his engage or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, then deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If you have a Ryze E Spell Flux mark, move away from allies to avoid the spread of Ryze Q Overload.

Shen.watch: Dodge the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash.
Shen.build: Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so do not build only one type of resistance. Being locked down by the taunt is dangerous, so consider tenacity first. Given his damage based on maximum health, avoid stacking only health.
Shen.fight: When Shen steps up for a last hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, lower his health with an auto attack or Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil and counterattack.
Shen.laning: After that, use short trades to benefit from the healing of Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, and push the wave to keep Shen occupied with CS.
Shen.combo: Once Shen E Shadow Dash is down, use this sequence: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, wait until it ends before auto attacking; you can keep dealing ability damage.
Shen.escape: The moment Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your chance to go in. If Shen R Stand United has not come back up yet, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil, then use the slow and backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding to create distance after attacking.
Shen.phase: In the late game, fight around Aurora's rise in win rate after she has three core items.
Shen.teamfight: Do not lead with Aurora R Between Worlds while Shen E Shadow Dash is available. After Shen's engage tool is down or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, layer on the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Also account for the possibility of Shen joining with Shen R Stand United when choosing when to start a fight.

Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings has three consecutive dashes, and its final hit knocks up, so back away when you see the first dash. Watch out for her follow-up attacks at close range because of the stun from Riven W Ki Burst and the empowered auto attacks from Riven P Runic Blade. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her attack damage and range increase, and its recast damage scales with missing health, so keep your distance until it expires.
Riven.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Riven deals mainly physical damage and Aurora has low armor, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, buy defensive items sooner.
Riven.fight: Right after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions is a chance to counterattack. When she dashes in, use the slow and backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding to respond and create distance. Try engaging first with Aurora W Across the Veil only when the kill is certain or Riven's mobility tools are down.
Riven.laning: When Riven steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in an auto attack to trigger Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then back off. After pushing the wave, you can use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and roam.
Riven.combo: For a short trade, use this sequence: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are down and you can go all in, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Recast after the auto attack and Aurora E The Weirding have lowered Riven's health to benefit from the damage based on missing health.
Riven.escape: Do not engage just because Riven E Valor is down. Look for a window before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back up when Riven E Valor is also down. If the stun from Riven W Ki Burst is still available, be wary of her counterattack once you get close.
Riven.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after three core items, so prioritize growing safely until then over forcing early kills.
Riven.teamfight: Do not lead with Aurora R Between Worlds while Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are available. After Riven's engage tools are down or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, then deal damage with the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If taking part in a kill resets the cooldown of Aurora W Across the Veil, use it for your next move.

Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker is dangerous when his Grit is full right after taking damage, so create distance after dealing damage and sidestep the center of its aiming line. Sett E Facebreaker stuns if it catches enemies on both sides, so do not stand across Sett from a minion wave. Do not go in first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Sett R The Show Stopper is available.
Sett.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Sett deals mainly physical damage and Aurora has low armor, so build armor first. If there is a lot of immobilizing crowd control aimed at Aurora, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items.
Sett.fight: When Sett steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in auto attacks to build passive stacks, then back off. Recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex after Sett has lost more health. Right after dealing heavy damage, watch for Sett W Haymaker and create distance. Engage during a window when Sett R The Show Stopper and Sett E Facebreaker are down.
Sett.laning: After pushing the wave, use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and roam.
Sett.combo: When Sett's engage tools are down and you can look for a kill, attack in this order: first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → approach with Aurora W Across the Veil → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Build passive stacks with the auto attack, use the backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding to create distance, then deal recast damage that scales with missing health.
Sett.escape: While Sett R The Show Stopper is down, Aurora has a chance to close the gap. If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, look to go in with Aurora W Across the Veil, but keep an escape option if the kill is not certain. As Sett engages, slow him with Aurora E The Weirding and leap backward.
Sett.phase: Aurora's win rate tends to rise after three core items, so prioritize safe poke and farming over forcing kills until then.
Sett.teamfight: After Sett R The Show Stopper is down or an ally lands crowd control, create a zone with Aurora R Between Worlds. Then layer on the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding and recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. To avoid the stun from Sett E Facebreaker, avoid positioning with allies on opposite sides of Sett.

Singed.watch: Do not chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. Aurora cannot use Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, or Aurora R Between Worlds to move while standing on Singed W Mega Adhesive, so go around it. Singed E Fling throws you behind him; keep your distance, especially when his team is behind him.
Singed.build: Prioritize movement speed to get out of Singed Q Poison Trail. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Singed's damage. Singed E Fling scales with maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Singed.fight: Take short trades after dodging Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling or seeing him use them. Land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in an auto attack to trigger Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then slow him with Aurora E The Weirding while backing away. Chase through Singed Q Poison Trail only when you have enough damage to secure the kill.
Singed.laning: After pushing the wave, use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and roam.
Singed.combo: When you have an opening, use Aurora Q Twofold Hex's first hit → Aurora W Across the Veil to approach → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → Aurora Q Twofold Hex's return hit. Lower Singed's health further with the auto attack and Aurora E The Weirding before the return hit to make use of its missing-health damage. Aurora E The Weirding makes Aurora leap opposite the cast direction, so check that the leap takes you away from Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Aurora W Across the Veil after Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are down. If Singed W Mega Adhesive is still under your feet, go around it first because you cannot use movement abilities there. If the kill is uncertain, do not force an engage expecting Aurora W Across the Veil's cooldown to reset.
Singed.phase: Singed becomes harder to kill once he has his core items in the mid game. Do not chase through his poison; focus on farming and roaming. Aurora's win rate rises after she completes three core items, so avoid forcing kills until then.
Singed.teamfight: Do not commit multiple teammates to Singed or chase him all the way through Singed Q Poison Trail. When Singed charges in, hold him with Aurora Q Twofold Hex and attack his teammates. After the enemy's engage abilities are down or an ally lands crowd control, enter with Aurora R Between Worlds, then follow with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora Q Twofold Hex's return hit.

Sylas.watch: Watch for the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct more than its first dash. If it hits, you are knocked up and exposed to a follow-up attack, so time Aurora W Across the Veil for the chain. Move out of the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash immediately. Sylas W Kingslayer heals more when his health is low, so do not drag out the finish.
Sylas.build: After completing your first core item, add Morellonomicon to reduce the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer. Sylas's main damage is magic damage, so choose magic resistance if you build defenses.
Sylas.fight: When Sylas steps up to last-hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, add auto attacks to stack Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then back off. If he engages with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct or Sylas W Kingslayer, counter with Aurora E The Weirding's slow and backward leap to create distance.
Sylas.combo: After countering Sylas's engage, take an opening with Aurora Q Twofold Hex's first hit → Aurora W Across the Veil to approach → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → Aurora Q Twofold Hex's return hit. The return hit scales with Sylas's missing health, so do not use it immediately after the first hit.
Sylas.escape: Dodge the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, then engage when both Sylas W Kingslayer and Sylas E Abscond / Abduct are down. If only one is down, he can escape with the remaining movement ability, so do not rush in.
Sylas.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after three core items. Early on, focus on harassing and farming instead of forcing kills.
Sylas.teamfight: Do not initiate with Aurora R Between Worlds while Sylas W Kingslayer and Sylas E Abscond / Abduct are available. Once Sylas engages with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct or an ally lands crowd control, create the zone with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal damage with Aurora E The Weirding's slow and Aurora Q Twofold Hex's return hit.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact charges through terrain and stuns you if it hits a wall, so do not stand with your back to one. If Skarner R Impale suppresses you, movement abilities such as Aurora W Across the Veil cannot break you free. Stay out of its short range.
Skarner.build: First decide whether you need to break free from Skarner R Impale, then choose whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build. Prioritize magic resistance to withstand his damage, but it will not block the physical damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval or Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If the enemy team has a lot of crowd control aimed at locking down Aurora, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items.
Skarner.fight: When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact comes in, slow him with Aurora E The Weirding and leap back to create distance. Just after Skarner uses Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil for a short trade, then leave the range of Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval's empowered auto attacks.
Skarner.laning: When the opponent steps up to last-hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in auto attacks to stack Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then land Aurora Q Twofold Hex's return hit. If you have pushed the wave, use Aurora W Across the Veil to cross terrain and roam.
Skarner.combo: After Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, attack with Aurora Q Twofold Hex's first hit → Aurora W Across the Veil to approach → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → Aurora Q Twofold Hex's return hit. The return hit scales with the target's missing health, so lower it with the auto attack and Aurora E The Weirding first. Aurora E The Weirding makes Aurora leap backward, so check where you will retreat.
Skarner.escape: Right after you draw out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your chance to close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil. If Skarner R Impale is available, do not enter its range; Aurora's movement abilities cannot free her once she is suppressed.
Skarner.phase: As Skarner builds tank items, both his damage and ability to hold targets grow stronger. Use early objective control to delay that point, and aim to complete three core items on Aurora.
Skarner.teamfight: Do not initiate with Aurora R Between Worlds while Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available. After Skarner's engage ability is down or an ally lands crowd control, create the zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, then deal area damage with Aurora E The Weirding's slow and Aurora Q Twofold Hex's return hit. At the edge of the dragon or Baron pit, do not stand against a wall: Skarner R Impale can drag you across the terrain.

Sion.watch: A long charge of Sion Q Decimating Smash makes its knockup and stun dangerous, so move sideways when he starts charging. Do not meet Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; dodge sideways rather than forward or backward. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor and slows you if it hits, so prioritize dodging it.
Sion.build: Sion deals mainly physical damage and Aurora has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor, build armor first, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. If the enemy team has a lot of crowd control that can lock down Aurora, fit Zhonya's Hourglass between core items.
Sion.fight: When Sion steps up to last-hit, hit him with the first part of Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in an attack to trigger Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then briefly back off. Right after Sion activates W Soul Furnace, use the chance to break the shield first and prevent the explosion. If Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, you can approach with Aurora W Across the Veil, but use W carefully as your escape if a kill isn’t certain.
Sion.laning: Move sideways out of Sion Q Decimating Smash's charge area. When Sion steps up to last-hit, take a short trade with Aurora Q Twofold Hex and auto attacks. Sion gains maximum health as he farms, so push the lane to disrupt his farming, or push the wave and use Aurora W Across the Veil to gain an advantage in another lane.
Sion.combo: After Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, attack with Aurora Q Twofold Hex's first hit → Aurora W Across the Veil to approach → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → Aurora Q Twofold Hex's return hit. Stack Aurora P Spirit Abjuration with the auto attack, leap backward with Aurora E The Weirding to create distance, then deal the missing-health damage from Aurora Q Twofold Hex's return hit.
Sion.escape: Move sideways to dodge the charged Sion Q Decimating Smash before going in; this lets you attack without taking its knockup and stun. If Sion engages with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, slow him and leap backward with Aurora E The Weirding, but check your retreat direction first.
Sion.phase: Sion keeps gaining maximum health from farming, so do not leave him alone. Disrupt his farming or gain an advantage in another lane. Until Aurora completes three core items, prioritize steady growth over forced kills.
Sion.teamfight: Do not initiate with Aurora R Between Worlds while Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is available. Once Sion has used his engage or an ally lands crowd control, create the zone with Aurora R Between Worlds, layer the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding, then land Aurora Q Twofold Hex's return hit. After taking Sion down, reposition instead of continuing to fight where he revives through Sion P Glory in Death.

Syndra.watch: Syndra R Unleashed Power is more dangerous where many spheres are on the ground. Watch for its execute when your health is low.
Syndra.build: Buy boots early for the movement speed to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak on foot. Build magic resistance against her main damage, but also get health to account for the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.fight: Right after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used, close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil and fight.
Syndra.combo: If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, use Aurora Q Twofold Hex's first hit → Aurora W Across the Veil to approach → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → Aurora Q Twofold Hex recast. Aurora E The Weirding deals damage and slows before leaping backward, so recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex from the distance it creates.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is Syndra's only self-defense tool, so right after she uses it is your chance to go in with Aurora W Across the Veil. Syndra has no mobility skill, so you can keep pressuring her once you close the gap. If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is still available, first avoid the stun along a sphere's path.
Syndra.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after three core items, so do not force early kills.
Syndra.teamfight: Move away from areas with many Syndra Q Dark Sphere spheres on the ground to avoid Syndra R Unleashed Power. Enter with Aurora R Between Worlds after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used or an ally applies crowd control, then deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and the recast of Aurora Q Twofold Hex.

TahmKench.watch: Three stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste from basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash open up a stun and Tahm Kench R Devour. If you have been hit twice, retreat out of range and wait for the stacks to expire. When you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive begin, move away from its landing spot to avoid the area knockup.
TahmKench.build: Build magic resistance first against the main damage from Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin prolongs fights, build Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
TahmKench.fight: Deal brief damage when Tahm Kench has no Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks, but avoid chasing too far for a difficult kill because Tahm Kench E Thick Skin can undo the damage. When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, making it harder for him to engage or escape, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, lower his health with basic attacks and Aurora E The Weirding, then recast it.
TahmKench.laning: When Tahm Kench steps up for a last hit, harass him with the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and a basic attack, then create distance with Aurora E The Weirding. After learning Aurora W Across the Veil, you can push the wave and roam.
TahmKench.combo: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down and you see a chance to kill him, use Aurora Q Twofold Hex's first hit → Aurora W Across the Veil to approach → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → Aurora Q Twofold Hex recast. Use the basic attack to build Aurora P Spirit Abjuration stacks, create distance with the slow and backward leap from Aurora E The Weirding, then deal recast damage that scales with missing health.
TahmKench.escape: Look to engage when Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down and he has trouble engaging or escaping. If he has two Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks on you, stay out of range and wait for them to expire. Before going in with Aurora W Across the Veil, judge whether you can reset its cooldown through a takedown.
TahmKench.phase: In the late game, look for fights after completing three core items, when Aurora's win rate rises.
TahmKench.teamfight: Enter with Aurora R Between Worlds after an enemy engage skill such as Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is used or an ally applies crowd control. If Tahm Kench swallows an ally, focus your damage on him while he is slowed.

Trundle.watch: Inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, Trundle gains attack speed and healing, so retreat outside it and wait out its duration. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks escape routes in narrow paths, so fight in open terrain and move sideways immediately when the pillar appears. Create distance while Trundle R Subjugate is active, since it steals your resistances and makes Trundle harder to kill.
Trundle.build: Trundle's main damage is physical and Aurora's armor is relatively low, so buy Cloth Armor early to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. Trundle has many ways to heal, so build Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Trundle.fight: When Trundle steps forward for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, weave in a basic attack to trigger Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, then back off. After he leaves Trundle W Frozen Domain, you can close the gap and attack with Aurora W Across the Veil if Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down. Keep your distance while Trundle R Subjugate is active.
Trundle.laning: Use short trades to get healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, but Trundle heals when nearby units die, so do not merely lower his health and let the laning phase drag on. After lowering his health, take an immediate advantage or push the wave to force him to recall.
Trundle.combo: When engaging, use Aurora Q Twofold Hex's first hit → Aurora W Across the Veil to approach → basic attack → Aurora E The Weirding → Aurora Q Twofold Hex recast. Aurora E The Weirding leaps backward after casting, so check the direction of your retreat.
Trundle.escape: Engage after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is used and Trundle W Frozen Domain expires. Trundle has no skill to create distance on his own, so approach with Aurora W Across the Veil and land Aurora Q Twofold Hex then. Do not force your way in with Aurora W Across the Veil unless the kill is certain.
Trundle.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after three core items, so farm safely until then and look for teamfights around objectives.
Trundle.teamfight: Enter with Aurora R Between Worlds after an engage tool such as Trundle E Pillar of Ice is used or an ally applies crowd control. Inside the area, add an area slow with Aurora E The Weirding and recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, keep your distance from Trundle or attack another target.

Talon.watch: If both the outgoing and returning hits of Talon W Rake connect, they build his passive stacks, so move out of the return path if the first hit lands. Do not chase too far while Talon R Shadow Assault is available, as he can use its stealth to escape or counterattack.
Talon.build: Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Talon's damage is physical, so prioritize armor and get health as well to withstand his flat penetration. Aurora's magic damage is easily reduced by Talon's high magic resistance, so build some magic penetration.
Talon.fight: When Talon steps up for a last hit, land the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in basic attacks to build passive stacks. Aurora Q Twofold Hex's recast deals more damage based on the target's missing health, so lower his health with basic attacks or Aurora E The Weirding before recasting. Zed.phase: Zed peaks in the mid game, so avoid giving him an early lead. In the late game, group with allies so no one is isolated and vulnerable to a pick. Farm safely until Aurora has three core items, when her win rate rises.
Zed.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark are available. After Zed uses his engage tools or an ally applies crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds, then follow the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding with an Aurora Q Twofold Hex recast.

Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and lowers resistances, so dodge the projectile before fighting. If Yorick W Dark Procession traps you, attack the wall to break it or cross it with Aurora W Across the Veil. If the Maiden of the Mist starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.
Yorick.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. Build armor first against the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers. If the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites prevents you from securing kills, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Yorick.fight: Start trading after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, in an area with few graves and Mist Walkers. When Yorick steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, stack your passive with auto attacks, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If the Maiden of the Mist is separately pushing a side lane, you have a chance to target Yorick himself.
Yorick.laning: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, step forward to harass him and push the wave toward his turret so he cannot build up graves on his side. After pushing the wave, you can roam with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Yorick.combo: When you have an opening to engage, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → Aurora W Across the Veil to approach → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → Aurora Q Twofold Hex recast. Aurora E The Weirding makes you leap backward after casting, so check your retreat direction.
Yorick.escape: Engage in the window after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses and Yorick W Dark Procession is down. Yorick has no ability to create distance himself, so you can approach with Aurora W Across the Veil. If a kill is not certain, do not force an engage with Aurora W Across the Veil; when Yorick comes in, slow him with Aurora E The Weirding and create distance.
Yorick.phase: In the mid game, answer Yorick's side lane pressure, then join your team. In the late game, use Aurora's strong period after completing three core items.
Yorick.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Yorick still has abilities available to respond to your engage. After the enemy uses its initiation abilities or an ally applies crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and an Aurora Q Twofold Hex recast. If your team needs to retreat, end Aurora R Between Worlds early and leave with them.

Zoe.watch: Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble can lead to heavy damage after the sleep, so dodge it. If it hits, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep takes effect so you wake up outside the angle of Zoe Q Paddle Star!. A missed bubble also leaves a trap, so beware of narrow paths and brush entrances without vision. Remember that Zoe always returns to her starting point after approaching with Zoe R Portal Jump.
Zoe.build: The available information does not determine a specific item purchase order. If you need defensive stats, build magic resistance rather than armor, and consider health to survive the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Prioritize dodging the bubble, since being put to sleep and hit by follow-up attacks is the greatest danger.
Zoe.fight: When Zoe steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex, lower her health with an auto attack and Aurora E The Weirding, then recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Once Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, close the gap with Aurora W Across the Veil and fight. If Zoe approaches with Zoe R Portal Jump, counterattack at the spot she will return to.
Zoe.laning: When Zoe steps forward for a last hit, take a short trade with Aurora Q Twofold Hex and an auto attack, using the healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. After pushing the wave, you can roam across terrain with Aurora W Across the Veil.
Zoe.combo: When Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, use the first hit of Aurora Q Twofold Hex → Aurora W Across the Veil to approach → auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → Aurora Q Twofold Hex recast. Do not recast Aurora Q Twofold Hex immediately; lower Zoe's health with an auto attack and Aurora E The Weirding first. Aurora E The Weirding makes you leap backward, so check your retreat direction.
Zoe.escape: The moment Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is your chance to engage with Aurora W Across the Veil. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, target the starting point she must return to, rather than where she appears.
Zoe.phase: Your win rate tends to rise in the late game after you have three core items, so keep up safe trades and farming until then.
Zoe.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Zoe's engage tool is available. After the enemy uses its initiation abilities or an ally applies crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal area damage with the slow from Aurora E The Weirding and an Aurora Q Twofold Hex recast. Around objectives, establish vision and watch for traps left by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so sidestep it as he approaches. After he lands it twice, his next Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks up; watch its sound and visual effect and adjust your distance in advance. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, go around it or save key abilities until it disappears.
Yasuo.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. Most of Yasuo's damage is physical and Aurora has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Yasuo.fight: Remove the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with cheap poke before committing to a trade. When Yasuo steps up for a last hit, land Aurora Q Twofold Hex and weave in auto attacks to stack your passive. Look to engage just after Yasuo fires the whirlwind from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, when his knockup stacks reset.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave slowly pushing toward your side so Yasuo has fewer minions to use as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Take short trades and use the healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration.
Yasuo.combo: If the engage can secure a kill, approach with Aurora W Across the Veil, then use an auto attack → Aurora E The Weirding → Aurora Q Twofold Hex recast. Recast after lowering his health with the auto attack and Aurora E The Weirding to make use of the damage based on missing health.
Yasuo.escape: Just after Yasuo fires the whirlwind from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is an opening to engage. Also look to engage with crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again, but Yasuo E Sweeping Blade has a short cooldown, so do not commit deep just because he used it once. If a kill is not certain, save Aurora W Across the Veil rather than using it to engage; when Yasuo comes in, slow him with Aurora E The Weirding and retreat.
Yasuo.phase: Aurora's win rate rises after three core items, so favor steady play over risky kills until then.
Yasuo.teamfight: Do not engage first with Aurora R Between Worlds while Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and Yasuo R Last Breath are available. After Yasuo uses his engage tools or an ally applies crowd control, create an area with Aurora R Between Worlds and deal damage with the area slow from Aurora E The Weirding and an Aurora Q Twofold Hex recast. If your team needs to retreat, end Aurora R Between Worlds early and leave with them.
